description.value: Quarrystone House is a bed and breakfast on five rural acres atop a Salt Spring Island ridgeline, with four private guest rooms in a building separate from the main farmhouse, each offering 180-degree ocean and sunset views from a private balcony or patio. Rooms include a private entrance, ensuite bathroom, two-person jacuzzi tub, gas fireplace, fridge, microwave, and coffee maker, with a three-course country breakfast served each morning at the main house. The property's pastoral setting — bordered by rolling sheep fields to the east and ocean views to the west — makes it a distinctive rural retreat on an island known for outdoor recreation.

address.value: 1340 Sunset Drive, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 1E2
